_doc: Figures the record legitimately quotes that trace to NO artifact in this checkout. Each needs a written reason. autoresearch/verify_cycle.py FAILs on any score-shaped figure in experiments/log.md that matches neither an artifact nor an entry here, so this file is the campaign's explicit list of numbers it is taking on trust. Keep it SHORT: an entry here is a promise that the number is foreign, not a way to silence the check.

figures.64.407341: hard-synthetic (gap.make_hard_synthetic_graph) PROTOTYPE-gate start value, H36 prototype table (log cycle 3). The prototype gate runs in scratch and by CAMPAIGN.md design does NOT write to results/; the log (line ~2756) records that these endpoints are not in the tracked proto_H36.json. A prototype figure, never a champion run.
figures.67.864913: hard-synthetic PROTOTYPE-gate end value paired with 64.407341 (+3.4576 pp), same H36 prototype table. Prototype-scratch by design; not a champion run.
figures.92.507675: mouse PROTOTYPE-gate start value (champion-style sift), H36 prototype table (log cycle 3). Prototype-scratch by design, not in results/; paired with 92.643455.
figures.92.643455: mouse PROTOTYPE-gate end value paired with 92.507675 (+0.1358 pp), same H36 prototype table. Prototype figure, never a champion run.
figures.92.9179: mouse, a DELIBERATELY degraded H42 run (--time-limit 3, scratch dir dr_tmp/guardtest/, explicitly not results/) used to test the runtime guard (log cycle 6). It scored above the champion's 92.9170 precisely because 'degraded' means 'not the configured computation', not 'worse' -- which is why the degraded flag is structural (requested-vs-done sweeps), not a score comparison. A guard-test artifact, by design not a results/ record.
figures.83.9101: connectome, H35, measured on the PREVIOUS machine (Apple MPS) before the Phase-7 port. It is the campaign's stated bootstrap number and the denominator of the 'gap closed' headline, but no CUDA record on this machine produces it: P01 re-measured the same champion at 83.9135 (results/*-H35-connectome-*-implement-*.json). Quoting 83.9101 is therefore a comparison against a foreign-hardware baseline. Consequence, stated so it is not lost: 0.0034 pp of the campaign's headline +0.2440 pp is a hardware/measurement artifact, and the campaign-attributable figure is +0.2406 pp.
figures.83.2069: microns, H30, same MPS-era provenance as 83.9101. P01 re-measured the microns champion on CUDA; use the CUDA figure for any delta that feeds a verdict.
figures.84.6147: the downloaded REFERENCE solution's score, read through mfas.analysis.gap for measurement only. It is the mission target, never produced by a run here, and by CAMPAIGN.md rule 4 it must never enter an algorithm. ATTRIBUTION CORRECTED 2026-08-16: this figure is 35,463,823 / 41,912,141 = 84.61468% and comes from data/best_solution/mfas_submission_soroush_35463823.csv.gz. It is NOT the score reported in Vahidi 2025 (arXiv:2506.13799), which is 35,462,925 = 84.6125% - 898 weight units lower. The FlyWire leaderboard attributes our file to a later 2026-01-09 Vahidi-Koutis entry (SSRN 6221201), which could not be retrieved (403, no arXiv version). The algorithm that produced the mission target is therefore UNKNOWN to this campaign. See autoresearch/lit/vahidi-2025.md.
figures.84.6125: the score actually reported in Vahidi 2025 (arXiv:2506.13799) = 35,462,925 / 41,912,141, retrieved from the arXiv HTML together with the authors' notebooks. Recorded here so the record stops conflating it with the 84.6147 reference file. Foreign figure, never produced by a run here.
figures.82.9161: the parity anchor: scoring results/rocket_best_positions.npy yields exactly 34,751,902 on total weight 41,912,141. It is pinned by tests/test_metrics.py rather than by a results/*.json record, which is why it has no run artifact.
figures.84.5875: FOREIGN - an EXTERNAL FlyWire leaderboard score, not a run of ours. Quoted in log.md cycle 12 from the divergent-mode literature scan (autoresearch/lit/scan-cycle12.md section 3) as the best independent NON-MIP precedent above our champion, attributed there to Hashorva. It is UNPUBLISHED - no paper, no code, no method description was retrievable - and the scan says so. It is cited only to bound what non-MIP methods are known to have reached; it is not a target, not a comparator, and must never enter an algorithm (CAMPAIGN.md rule 4).
figures.84.4019: FOREIGN - an EXTERNAL FlyWire leaderboard score, not a run of ours. Same provenance as 84.5875: log.md cycle 12, from autoresearch/lit/scan-cycle12.md section 3, attributed to Zheng-Tang-Okubo and likewise UNPUBLISHED. Cited only as non-MIP precedent; not a target and not a comparator.
